title: Path traversal in download_file
fix: Resolve the real path and require it to stay under UPLOAD_DIR.

title: Command injection via shell=True
fix: Pass an argument list without shell=True.

title: Insecure deserialization of cookie with pickle
fix: Use signed JSON (e.g. HMAC) instead of pickle.

title: Unsalted MD5 password hashing
fix: Use a slow salted KDF such as hashlib.scrypt or argon2.
